test_lacking_copy_ctor: test that pybind11 raises RuntimeError when returning a non-copyable C++ object by value
test_lacking_move_ctor: test that pybind11 raises RuntimeError when returning an object that is neither movable nor copyable
test_move_and_copy_casts: test pybind11 type casters and verify move and copy construction counts for MoveOnlyInt, MoveOrCopyInt, and CopyOnlyInt
test_move_and_copy_loads: test pybind11 argument loading via type casters and count moves and copies for move-only, copy-only, and nested types
test_move_and_copy_load_optional: test pybind11 move and copy loads of std::optional arguments and verify construction counts
